info.name: Smart Parking
info.description: All requests go through the gateway ({{baseUrl}}). One folder per service/feature; run top to bottom, IDs are chained through the environment.

exec: // A fresh driver per run, so earlier runs or the frontend demo never block a reservation.

item.name: Too many reservation attempts are refused

exec: // The gateway allows a few reservation attempts per driver in a row (5 per minute by default).
// A fresh driver makes 10 attempts on spots that don't exist (404, nothing is reserved),
// so this request is over the limit whatever the configured number up to 10.
